basis: PREREG_H1_TF A5.3 (rotation and ladder contrasts), F6.2/F6.3 (exact predecessor gradient for the ten chain picks), F8.3 with F8a.3/F9a.2 (row content and edge values), F11 (52 edits); PRESCORE_INVENTORY gate 5
outcomes_read: none: no evaluation record, TF-v1 score, rotation/ladder outcome or sealed outcome is opened; only stored edit bytes, staged variant files, the base model and the G2 WikiText artefacts

abstentions.abstain:q_partial: q incomplete (nonzero tensor without factors): kappa, t*, forecast abstain
abstentions.abstain:rotation_pair_excluded_at_stagin: rotation pair excluded at staging (F10.3): no R_eff exists; prediction null
abstentions.abstain:uncovered_tensor: a nonzero staged tensor outside the gradient's support; prediction null

predictor.chart: abstain:no_frozen_chart_predictor (F8 spec 3.5); no chart model exists
predictor.contraction: response_field.contract arithmetic (fp32 per tensor), summed with math.fsum; fp64 recomputation kept for the sign check

gradient_sources.base_field: root edits (30 LoRA picks, 12 F11 supplements): G2 base field, the exact anchor
gradient_sources.chain_exact: registered chain picks: F6.2 exact WikiText gradient at the actual predecessor (base for the two root picks)

predictor.increments: as staged: R_eff and ladder increments read from the staged files (sha256 = manifest delta_sha256); D_eff rebuilt from stored zoo bytes as build_variants builds it; staged ladders re-derived bitwise
predictor.kappa: q/|a| with F8a.3(b) edge statuses; t* = |a|/q only for a < 0 < q (row-relative); edit s_star_nominal = |a_1|/q_1 (nominal full-strength-direction forecast, not a ladder-point forecast)
predictor.ladder: <g, bf16(W + s*Delta) - W>, s in (0.25, 0.5) (A5.3 'Ladder'; predicts the sign of y(W + s*Delta) - y(W) at the actual predecessor W, as the analysis computes it)
predictor.q: sum over tensors of 1/2 tr(G X A X^T) with the base K-FAC spectral factors (base-factor for every row, F6.2); unsigned Fisher magnitude; descriptive only (F8a.3(b))
predictor.quadratic_forecast: ladder/edit: sign(a_s + q_s) (F8a.3(a)); rotation: (a_D + q_D) - (a_R + q_R) (F9a.2(b)); descriptive, never enters Part A, A5.5 or F5.5
predictor.rotation: <g, D_eff - R_eff> (A5.3; predicts the sign of y(W + D) - y(W + R))
